news.title: Riddhi Display Equipments Limited Announces Chief Financial Officer Changes, Effective February 16, 2026
news.body: Riddhi Display Equipments Limited announced that at the board meeting held on February 16, 2026, the resignation of Mr. Vandankumar Mahendrabhai Dave from the position of Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of the Company due to his preoccupation elsewhere, effective from the close of business hours on February 16, 2026. Mr. Vandankumar Mahendrabhai Dave confirmed that his resignation is tendered due to personal reasons and that there are no other material reasons for his resignation. Mr. Dave further confirmed that he has duly discharged all his duties and responsibilities during his tenure as Chief Financial Officer and undertook to complete all necessary handover and transition formalities as may be required by the Company to ensure a smooth transition.
